entity.description: A staff invitation: an address, the organization the invited person will work for (a relationship of relationshipTypeEnumId), the grant proposal (registered bundles, checked when it is sent and again when it is accepted) and a single-use token, kept only as its hash, that lasts until expiresDate. statusId is UinvPending until it is accepted (UinvAccepted, with the account it went to) or revoked (UinvRevoked); a pending one past expiresDate reads as expired (UinvExpired). A resend gives it a new token, so the earlier one no longer matches. operationKey makes a retry of the same request answer this invitation. The token itself is mailed, or shown once to the inviter when the instance cannot send mail (linkShownDate); it is never stored, listed or logged. Read and changed only through mantle.party.IdentityServices.

field.name: emailAddress
field.description: The invited address; the account the invitation goes to has it.

field.name: firstName
field.description: The person's name when the invitation makes a new person.

field.name: partyId
field.description: An existing person the inviter chose, or the person the acceptance made or matched.

field.name: userId
field.description: The account the invitation was accepted with.

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The internal organization the person will work for; the organization entity filters apply to it.

field.name: relationshipTypeEnumId
field.description: PrtEmployee, PrtAgent or PrtMember.

field.name: bundleGroupIds
field.description: The grant proposal: registered bundles (UserGroup ids, comma separated) the app supplied, validated structured data, never executable.

field.name: message
field.description: The inviter's note in the email.

field.name: tokenHash
field.description: The hash of the current token (singleUseCodeHash); never the token.

field.name: sentDate
field.description: When the current token was issued (sent, or made for the link shown).

field.name: mailSent
field.description: Y when the current token went out by mail.

field.name: linkShownDate
field.description: When the acceptance link of the current token was shown to the inviter, the instance having no mail server; audited, without the token.

field.name: factorId
field.description: The authenticator factor the acceptance made when a bundle's group requires one, until its first code confirms it.

field.name: acceptVisitId
field.description: The session (Visit) the acceptance ran in: only it, or the account signed in, sees the factor step and its key.

field.name: operationKey
field.description: The caller's key of the request: a retry with the same key answers this invitation.

entity.description: One lifecycle request of an account: a global disable (now, or at a future date written to the account's terminateDate), the removal from one internal organization (its relationships, and the account's memberships when no organization is left), or a restoration (enabled again, no credential or schedule brought back). Its independent steps (UserLifecycleOperationStep) each keep their own outcome: a failed step leaves the others, and the revocation, in place and stays to be retried. organizationPartyId is the organization it was requested for (the one removed, or for a global operation the target's organization in the requester's scope), which the organization entity filters apply to. operationKey makes a retry of the same request answer this operation. Read and changed only through mantle.party.IdentityServices.

field.name: userId
field.description: The account the operation is about.

field.name: kindEnumId
field.description: UlkDisable, UlkOrgRemoval or UlkRestore.

field.name: isGlobal
field.description: Y for an account-wide operation (disable, restore), N for one organization's removal.

field.name: effectiveDate
field.description: When it takes effect; a future date of a disable is the account's terminateDate, of a removal the relationships' end.

field.name: sourceReference
field.description: The requesting record, as its owner names it (People's operation key, later); empty for Admin's own requests.

field.name: statusId
field.description: UlopCompleted, UlopScheduled (taking effect at its date) or UlopAttention (a step failed or waits for an owner).

field.name: accountRevision
field.description: The account revision the request named.

entity.description: One independent step of a lifecycle operation: the account's own (disable, end date, access revoked, relationships and memberships ended, enabled again) or a participant's (an owner's pause, or a resource waiting for a new owner through the owner's transfer service, design-admin §14). It keeps the target identity, the provider and its action, the state, the attempts and the reason; never a copy of the owner's records or a secret. A participant step names only a service carrying the owned-resource contract (org.moqui.admin.IdentityServices define#OwnedResourceTransfer or define#OwnedResourcePause).

field.name: stepKind
field.description: disableAccount, endDate, revokeAccess, endRelationships, endMemberships, enableAccount, pause or transfer.

field.name: providerKey
field.description: identity for the account's own steps, else the participant's key (the app's registration).

field.name: actionService
field.description: A participant step's service (the owner's pause or transfer).

field.name: resourceParameter
field.description: The owner's name for the resource's id among the transfer service's parameters.

field.name: toUserId
field.description: The new owner a transfer went to.

field.name: statusId
field.description: UlstDone, UlstFailed, UlstWaiting (for a new owner) or UlstSkipped.
